en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large steel railway truss bridge with three arched spans crossing a wide river. Stone piers rise from the water, and river traffic includes a long barge passing under the bridge and a smaller boat docked in the right foreground. Low, flat land is visible in the distance. Handwritten-style text at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Spoorbrug." and faint lettering is present on the side of the bridge structure.
